Registered Nurse salary in Arizona

Based on 9 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 27, 2026), listed pay for Registered Nurse jobs in Arizona is $122,975–$127,923 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $122,976 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $122,976 a year across 9 current postings. The middle 50% is $122,975–$127,923 a year.

Which employers list the highest pay?

Veterans Health Administration: about $122,976 a year (median of 9 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

Is this a salary survey?
